description: This file defines a React context and provider component for managing learner progress state in an educational application. It imports state management functions from an external store, creates context, and provides hooks for consuming learner progress data and actions.

methods.name: LearnerProgressProvider
methods.description: Provides learner progress state through React Context to child components, initializes state, subscribes to updates, and supplies learner progress actions.

methods.name: useLearnerProgress
methods.description: Custom hook to access learner progress context, throws error if used outside provider.
